commit_message:
refactor(au): one backend-factory seam for async_compute and the simple API (#24 item 1)

au.base._backend_factory replaces the two override globals (au.base._default_backend
and mock_async's overwrite of au.api._default_backend). mock_async installs a
factory building TrackingTestBackends that share one tracker and carry each
surface's middleware, so middleware given to async_compute now runs under the mock.
